text:
maya: Quick sync — we need a compact naming guideline for audit events that are customer-visible. Current drafts diverge (some use dot.case, others snake_case, some include product prefixes).
enrique: Agreed. Can we pick a single canonical pattern and a migration strategy?
liz: product wants human-readable names in the UI, but we also need stable machine IDs for integrations.
samir: QA flagged tests breaking because event names changed across deploys last week. We need backwards-compatible aliases.
maya: Proposal: machine id = kebab-case with short prefix e.g. `rbac-user-added`, customer label = Title Case phrase e.g. "RBAC User Added". Keep machine id immutable.
enrique: +1 on kebab for machine ids. Suggest rule: <domain>-<resource>-<action> where domain is one of `rbac|kms|auth|admin|billing`.
liz: Can we map domain -> UI group so UI shows "Access (RBAC)"? Also ask legal about customer-facing verb forms.
samir: For migration: add `aliases` array to event schema and emit both current id and legacy id when renaming for one release cycle. Then drop alias after 90 days.
maya: KMS integration question: should events include full key ARN or just key alias/id? Security prefers alias/id with hashed ARN in details for correlation. Thoughts?
enrique: Include `key_id` and a `key_digest` (sha256) field. Keep `key_arn` only in internal logs, not customer-visible.
security-bot: Incident note: previous leak was traced to `key_arn` exposure in customer-facing logs. Confirmed.
maya: Good call. Also: RBAC changes emit actor (user id/email) and subject (resource id) — subject should be namespaced like `team:123/role:ops`.
liz: For naming verbs, product suggests using past tense for events representing completed actions (e.g., `role-assigned`) and present continuous for in-flight states (rare). Keep it simple — prefer past tense.
enrique: Example schema snippet we should standardize across teams:
```json
{"event_id":"rbac-role-assigned","occurred_at":"...","actor":{"id":"u_123","email":"..."},"subject":{"type":"role","id":"r_456"},"aliases":["rbac.assign_role_v1"]}
```
maya: Also require `customer_visible: true|false` top-level flag so downstream consumers can filter.
samir: We should add a lint rule in the event linter to enforce the <domain>-<resource>-<action> pattern and alias presence on rename. I can add tests.
liz: Timeline: product + security to sign off on canonical list by EOD Friday, eng-platform to implement aliases and lint next sprint.
maya: Action items: 1) liz to collate UI labels -> due Thu. 2) enrique to draft JSON schema update PR -> due Fri. 3) samir to add linter tests -> due next Tue. 4) security to confirm no sensitive fields make customer_visible -> asap.
enrique: I'll include a migration checklist in the PR (emit both ids, deprecate notice, monitoring rule).
maya: Thanks — ping me if you need a quick review. :thumbsup:
